name: Eurasia — CIS Countries
tagline: Where Europe ends and Asia has not yet begun.
headline: Silk Road Cities, Caucasus Valleys and the Caspian Shore

groups.name: Georgia
groups.tagline: 5 Nights, 6 Days · Tbilisi, Batumi, Gori, Uplistsikhe, Gudauri

offer.summary: 6 days trip built around Tbilisi, Batumi, Gori, Uplistsikhe, Gudauri at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Eurasia journeys we shape by hand through Eurasia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Stroll through the charming Old Town, discover Narikala Fortress and enjoy the city's warm blend of history, balconies and riverside views.
Experience the vibrant coastal energy of Batumi, where modern architecture meets the Black Sea, featuring iconic landmarks like the Ali and Nino statue and a scenic seaside boulevard.
Explore Gori Fortress and the city's layered history in the birthplace of Joseph Stalin.
Wander through an ancient rock-hewn city of tunnels, chambers and temples carved into the Mtkvari Valley cliffs.
Soak in sweeping Caucasus views at this high-altitude resort, with skiing, mountain adventures and the nearby Gergeti Trinity Church.

groups.name: Azerbaijan
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Baku, Shamakhi, Gabala, Sheki, Absheron Peninsula

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Baku, Shamakhi, Gabala, Sheki, Absheron Peninsula at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Eurasia journeys we shape by hand through Eurasia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Wander through the medieval Old City, admire the Flame Towers and enjoy panoramic Caspian views from Highland Park
Discover Shirvan's historic heart through the graceful Juma Mosque and the cliffside Diri Baba Mausoleum
Escape into lush Caucasus landscapes with forested valleys, mountain views and the scenic Tufandag cable-car experience.
Step into Silk Road history at the UNESCO-listed Khan's Palace, famed for its exquisite Shebeke stained-glass windows.
Witness Azerbaijan's ancient fire heritage at Ateshgah Fire Temple and the ever-burning flames of Yanar Dag.

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Almaty, Kok Tobe, Charwak Lake, Samarkand at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Eurasia journeys we shape by hand through Eurasia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Discover a lively city framed by Tian Shan peaks, leafy avenues and elegant cultural landmarks.
Rise above Almaty for sweeping city views, mountain horizons and a peaceful hilltop escape.
Relax beside an azure mountain reservoir surrounded by green slopes, rocky peaks and tranquil waters
Step into the Silk Road's golden past at Registan Square, Shah-i-Zinda and the majestic Timurid monuments.

highlights: Explore Chorsu Bazaar, the elegant metro and the blue-domed Hazrat Imam Complex in Uzbekistan's vibrant capital.
Escape to turquoise waters, fresh mountain air and scenic Chimgan landscapes perfect for boating and relaxation.
Wander through the majestic Registan, Shah-i-Zinda and Gur-e-Amir, where every blue-tiled monument echoes the Silk Road.
